title: Case: Workshop checks arrangements for a three-pallet shelving delivery
context: Three pallets of steel shelving (order TG-963, shipment DL-963) are booked to Kestrel Yard Workshop. The carrier's Freight planner owns vehicle allocation.
initial_request: Morning. Just checking everything is set for the three pallets tomorrow. Tail lift is sorted, yes? I saw a confirmation come through on Monday.

events.body: DL-963 booked: 3 pallets, 410 kg each, 2026-05-14 AM to Kestrel Yard Workshop. Allocated vehicle: standard curtain-sider, dock-level or forklift unload by consignee. Any change of vehicle type has to reach the freight planner on this portal by 16:00 UTC the working day before delivery, otherwise the allocation stands.

events.from: Dunya Abara, Kestrel Yard Workshop receiving coordinator
events.body: Hi Iona, few things, sorry for the essay. First, the single pallet coming tomorrow, the fixings one, can it come before 11 because we have the fire alarm test at half past and everyone has to be out in the yard. Second, I never got the delivery note for the March order, the one with the castors, accounts keep asking me and I keep saying I'll ask. Third and this is the main one for next week, our forklift went off for repair on Friday and the hire company now say it will not be back until the 20th, so anything that turns up before then we can only take off a tail lift with a pallet truck, we have nothing here to lift a pallet off the side of a lorry. That is the three pallets of shelving on the 14th. I did tell the rep this on the phone but I do not know if it got written down anywhere. Fourth, could the drivers please stop using the staff car park entrance, the barrier is too low and one of them clipped it last month. Thanks, Dunya
DL-934, Kestrel Yard Workshop, 1 pallet, 2026-05-12: tail-lift vehicle with pallet truck confirmed. Arrival before 11:00 requested, not guaranteed.
This is an automated receipt. Your portal message has been logged. Reference numbers beginning FP are for portal use only and are not booking confirmations.

Palletised deliveries booked for this morning may arrive in the afternoon. Consignees do not need to rebook. Plover Arc Logistics Ltd. Please consider the environment before printing.
DL-934 delivered 10:38, 1 pallet, unloaded by tail lift, signed D. Abara.

events.from: Reuben Castellane, Kestrel Yard Workshop accounts
events.body: Replying to all. I don't think I should be on this thread, I only asked Dunya for the March delivery note. If someone has it please send it to accounts and take me off the rest. Reuben Castellane, Accounts Assistant, Kestrel Yard Workshop Ltd. Registered in England. This email may contain privileged information.

events.from: Dunya Abara, Kestrel Yard Workshop receiving coordinator
events.body: Today's driver was fine and on time, thank you, but he came in through the staff car park again. Can that go on the notes for all our deliveries.
DL-988 not yours I think but tagging you anyway, pallet refused at Marrow Street, wrong consignee name. Ignore if not relevant.
Daily summary for your account. Delivered yesterday: DL-934. Booked next 3 days: DL-963 (14 May, curtain-sider), DL-979 (15 May, rigid 18t). No exceptions open.

events.to: Dunya Abara, Kestrel Yard Workshop receiving coordinator
events.body: Trade customers: our summer racking catalogue is out now. Order by 29 May for pre-holiday delivery. To stop receiving trade mailings reply STOP.

events.from: Dunya Abara, Kestrel Yard Workshop receiving coordinator
events.body: Morning. Just checking everything is set for the three pallets tomorrow. Tail lift is sorted, yes? I saw a confirmation come through on Monday.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the Freight planner, before the 16:00 UTC cut-off, to change DL-963 to a tail-lift vehicle with pallet truck because the consignee has no forklift until 2026-05-20, and to confirm.

must: Sends a vehicle-change request for DL-963 to the Freight planner on the Freight portal
States that Kestrel Yard Workshop has no forklift until 2026-05-20 and needs a tail-lift vehicle with a pallet truck for the 3 pallets on 2026-05-14
Asks the Freight planner to confirm the changed allocation, noting the 16:00 UTC cut-off today
must_not: Tell Dunya Abara that a tail lift is confirmed for DL-963 (the tail-lift confirmation in the thread was for DL-934)
State that the vehicle change has been made before the Freight planner confirms it
Advise the workshop on how to unload pallets without a forklift
expected.reference_message: Vehicle change request for DL-963 (3 pallets, 410 kg each, Kestrel Yard Workshop, 2026-05-14 AM). The consignee's forklift is away for repair until 2026-05-20, so they cannot unload a curtain-sider. They can only receive from a tail lift with a pallet truck. Please change the allocation to a tail-lift vehicle with pallet truck and confirm on this portal. I understand the cut-off for vehicle changes is 16:00 UTC today. If a tail-lift vehicle is not available for the 14th, please say what the options are so I can put them to the consignee.

rationale: DL-963 is allocated a curtain-sider that assumes forklift unload, and the consignee said her forklift is away until the 20th. The tail-lift confirmation she remembers was for DL-934, already delivered. The Freight planner owns the vehicle and set a 16:00 cut-off the day before, so the desk must ask now.
